pr_title: gpio/it8xxx2: do not set flag if register does not exist
pr_body:
Since not all GPIOs support voltage selection, voltage flag is only set if voltage selection register is present.

fixes: #54366

Signed-off-by: Dino Li <Dino.Li@ite.com.tw>

issue_context.title: tests: pin_get_config failed on it8xxx2_evb, again
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
Test case `tests/drivers/gpio/gpio_basic_api` failed in daily test. 
When setting a GPIO to high, and then getting the GPIO result, the result is not as expected.
The test fails, noticing the discrepancy between the set flags and the gotten flags. However, on this board, the discrepancy is the expected and correct result.

The `it8xxx2_evb` board uses some flags as read-only flags, informing the receiver and user about e.g. the voltage used for the pin. Thus, on this board and possibly some others, the assertion that set flags on a GPIO port will be the same as gotten flags on the same port is incorrect.

Please also mention any information which could help others to understand
the problem you're facing:
 - What target platform are you using?
   - `it8xxx2_evb`, also called `IT81302 MECC`
 - What have you tried to diagnose or workaround this issue?
   - To diagnose it, I have locally modified the test in question to verify what flags were set and gotten.
     - Set flags: `1010 0000 0000 0000 0000`
     - Got flags: `1010 0001 0000 0000 0000`
   - I have not tried to workaround this issue, as it's an issue in the test.
 - Is this a regression? 
   - Yes. 
   - The test has worked between commits [99ab3fb](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/commit/99ab3fba5454b8ef6bbb6ff6ca7f48d1173691f6) and [b2962d2](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/52156/commits/b2962d241fc814c0a05d3d76bb71f3119f087c2b)
   - The [b2962d2](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/52156/commits/b2962d241fc814c0a05d3d76bb71f3119f087c2b) has changed how the test in question works. The operation of this test should be returned to the previous state, keeping in mind that the mask originally used has been deprecated.
   - The conversation about solving this issue can be found in [Issue 47921](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/47921), which had found this problem originally, and the [PR 47923](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/47923), which fixed it.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Prepare the `it8xxx2_evb` for the test, looping `OUT 0` to `IN 1` (`gpio_loopback` fixture).
2. Run `<path/to/twister/>twister  -p it8xxx2_evb --device-testing --west-flash="<path/to/loader/>itetool/loader.sh" --device-serial=<tty_port_connected_to_the_board> -T <path/to/tests/>tests/drivers/gpio/gpio_basic_api/ --fixture=gpio_loopback`

**Expected behavior**
The test in question (`gpio_port.test_gpio_port`) passes.

**Impact**
  - Annoyance
  - Loss of daily test result clarity
  - Possible further impacts if, during further Zephyr development, there is a mistaken expectation of reading the same flags as one has set on every board.
